::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 1st 1894  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e.174 ff 139-40
:::

Dear [Mr Bullock](people/person_221.qmd),
I think that with the book of Shropshire worthies I could manage [Fletcher](people/person_1677.qmd)’s life. [Lady Falkland](people/person_2408.qmd) is so well done in Miss Kavanagh’s [Women of Christianity](other_books/otherbook_91.qmd) that I think I could write her from thence.[^1] I suppose you are entirely at sea as to disposing of [the book](other_books/otherbook_118.qmd) and cannot tell at all what you could allow the writers

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The biographies of the Rev. John William Fletcher and of Lettice, Viscountess Falkland were among the 'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans' intended for Bullock's *Daily Lections* project, but were never published.
